size_rationale: Medium because the symptom shows at login after PATCH or reset-password, but the cause sits one step away in the User model's pre-save hook, which every save goes through.
prompt: After a user changes their password through PATCH /v1/users/:userId or the reset-password flow, they can no longer log in: POST /v1/auth/login returns 401 'Incorrect email or password' for both the new and the old password. Users who never changed their password log in fine.

root_cause.detail: The pre-save hook hashes only when user.isNew instead of whenever the password is modified, so password changes on existing users are stored in plaintext and bcrypt.compare fails at login.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > PATCH /v1/users/:userId > should return 200 and successfully update user if data is ok
tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/reset-password > should return 204 and reset the password
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 200 and successfully update user if data is ok|should return 204 and reset the password'
